accepted_claims: F09 is a new prospective phase-sensitive lathe fixture that binds body-fixed azimuth, spindle phase and axial feed to one exact synchronized parameter and includes closed-endpoint plus signed phase neighbours.

F10 is a new prospective many-body fixture in which seven exact through-slots yield eight retained positive-volume components with durable identities, while an arbitrarily small positive residual web remains one connected component.
F11 is a new prospective machining-generated singular-boundary fixture with exact separated, tangent and penetrating passage relations and an exact shared tangent point.

F12 is a new prospective scale/precision fixture retaining an exact 1/1000000 mm web at translated large coordinates and under an exact rigid rotation without allowing translation, scale or tolerance to consume the feature.
Task-local expected truth is derived with exact rational predicates independent of candidate and historical RCS geometry implementations.
F09-F12 may progress from UNBUILT to BUILT; BUILT does not mean native candidate PASS, proof-obligation acceptance, MC-B acceptance or MC-1 acceptance.
open_claims: No native geometry candidate has been executed or qualified on F09-F12.
MC-B through MC-F and MC-1 remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
General transcendental/tangential phase-event completeness, arbitrary imported solids, universal topology, reconstruction and STEP engineering qualification remain under downstream owners.
MC-007 PB-007 blockers and all other inherited unresolved required claims remain open.
adversarial_controls: reject binary-float authority, epsilon phase/contact predicates and candidate-defined expected truth
detect F09 phase averaging, phase/feed decoupling, lost equality endpoints and signed phase-neighbour collapse
detect F10 deletion of positive-volume bodies or rounding any positive support web into separation
detect F11 epsilon collapse of separated/tangent/penetrating singular relations
detect F12 translation/rotation precision loss, zero/negative boundary collapse and deletion of a positive 1/1000000 mm web
reject protected historical-source edits, fixture denominator shrinkage, optionalization and premature capability promotion

review.notes: Acceptance is limited to prospective fixture/oracle construction; no native geometry or MC-B claim is made.
